TELECOM CONSUMERS PROTECTION
TELECOM CONSUMERS PROTECTION
(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS,
2010
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
14th July, 2010]
S.R.O. 658(I)/2010, dated 8-6-2010.---In exercise of
powers conferred under sub-clause (o) of subsection (2) of section 5 of the
Pakistan Telecommunication (Re-Organization) Act, 1996, the Pakistan
Telecommunication Authority is pleased to notify following amendments in the
Telecom Consumers Protection Regulations, 2009.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) These
Regulations shall be called the Telecom Consumers Protection (Amendment)
Regulations, 2010.
(2) They shall come into force from the date of gazette
notification.
At page 1080 regulation 6 shall be substituted as
follows:
"(1) Operators may withdraw the provision of any
limited time offer or bundle packages for Services from Consumers, provided
that such withdrawal is approved by the Authority, if required and thirty (30)
days prior notice is given to Consumers:
Provided that in exceptional circumstances an
operator may with prior written approval of the Authority, withdraw the
provision of any limited time offer or bundle package for services from
Consumers.
(2) The notice
required in sub-regulation (1) shall be served through any of the following
means:
(i) Short messaging service;
(ii) Website; and
(iii) Print media.
Explanation.--For the purpose of these
regulations `packages for value added services' shall include but not be
limited to Short Messaging Service, Universal Access Service, Toll Free
Service, Premium Rate Service, Content Based Service, Internal Service or any
other Service as determined by the Authority from time to time".
At page 1080 after clause (vii) in sub-regulation (2)
of regulation 7, the following shall be inserted.
"(viii) Press Advertisement".
At page 1080 after the first proviso appearing in
sub-regulation (3) of regulation 7, the following new proviso shall be
inserted:
"Provided further that for each connection of
the same Service subscribed in consumer's own name, a prior intimation for disconnection
shall be given in the notice served under sub-regulation (2) of regulation
7".
At page 1084 after clause (iv) of sub-regulation (1)
of regulation 10 the following new clause shall be inserted:
"(v) that no change in tariff shall be imposed
by the operator unless a prior notice of seven (7) days is served through any
of the means specified in sub-regulation (2) of regulation 7 and the same is
placed on website of the concerned Operator".
